name: excalidraw-interaction-recorder
description: Desktop app for recording Excalidraw interactions.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json && vite build
scripts.pack:mac: npm run icon && npm run build && electron-builder --mac --dir
scripts.dist:mac: npm run icon && npm run build && electron-builder --mac
scripts.pack:linux: npm run icon && npm run build && electron-builder --linux --dir
scripts.dist:linux: npm run icon && npm run build && electron-builder --linux AppImage tar.xz
scripts.dist:linux:pacman: npm run icon && npm run build && electron-builder --linux pacman
scripts.install:mac: npm run pack:mac && rm -rf "/Applications/Excalidraw Recorder.app" && cp -R "release/mac-arm64/Excalidraw Recorder.app" "/Applications/" && rm -rf "release/mac-arm64"
